CJdropshipping confirmed free-to-join via WebSearch and its live service-fee page (cjdropshipping.com/service-fee), as the main site redirects to a bot-validation page. All telephony fields are null (not a telephony vertical). All accessedAt = 2026-06-15. Corrections applied: AutoDS Advanced 1K monthlyUsd 66.90 -> 69.90 (official Help Center) and annual-discount roundings recomputed from verified monthly/annual pairs. Syncee Plus ($299.99 / 50,000 products) was double-checked against the official help article and confirmed real (not fabricated). No vendors or plans removed.
